audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4, 5 and 6 gave the late game to Akali in both layers, contradicting the packet levelChart (Kayle at 5-7), the 54.05% win rate, and whys[4]/[5]/[6], which all describe Kayle taking over.
audit.why: Divine Ascent goes ranged at 11 and Divine Judgment blanks Perfect Execution's execute; a squishy assassin loses to ranged AoE on-hit once Nashor's lands.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5 and 6 set to Kayle in both layers with ratings raised.

audit.why: spikes[] already name Divine Ascent at 6, Nashor's at first item, and her R window; the mirror audit made the same corrections from Akali's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block carried no numbers and did not state that Twilight Shroud stops targeted casts but not Kayle's Q skillshot; Assassin's Mark auto-reset tell was absent.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 and Perfect Execution 120/90/60 — those numbers decide when to step up. The ring proc is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to back off.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now carry the numbers and the skillshot interaction; dontsFull[1] names the ring proc tell.

edits.before: Untargetable inside. Scale past it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Untargetable inside, 20s at rank 1 — but Q is a skillshot and still lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Assassin's Mark empowers her next auto — the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Scale past it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 — untargetable inside, yet your Q is a skillshot and still hits her line. - Perfect Execution: 120s at rank 1. - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — kill windows only, never chip.
